cross_product_finding: RECURRENCE of the known anomaly logged in docs-issues/capella-pages-cite-server-versions.json, twice on this one page: (1) 'The describe statement introduced in the Couchbase Server 4.1 release has been renamed to INFER' and (2) 'The ~meta attribute is only available in Couchbase Server 8.0 and later.' Both cite literal Server version numbers on a Capella-only page. Confirms the credential-type/privilege model extends cleanly to INFER: it names the same Basic->Read / Advanced->Query Read pair as LET and JOIN in this same batch, with no requiresCapellaRole gate (INFER is a data-plane, read-only DDL-adjacent statement, not a management-plane action).
